title: Three more things people built
summary:
New community apps arrived, and the paths to finding projects and understanding the API got clearer.

RuangRiung AI Image Generator, which supports Indonesian and English, and ImageGen AI Image joined the creative-app listings. FoodAnaly joined the LLM Integrations list with food, nutrition, and dietary analysis. A useful reminder that the catalog is mostly people building things.

Project listings gained GitHub star counts and now put more-starred projects first. Counts above 1,000 are abbreviated. The underlying project CSV separately changed to put older submissions before newer ones.

Five public metadata resources were added for endpoints, models, capabilities, services, and usage guidance, giving agents more structured information about the API.

Text API ad selection gained case-insensitive domain matching and an Origin check when a referrer is absent. Conversations that already contain a Pollinations redirect link now skip another ad, including while streaming. Mistral Small 3 changed provider routing, and image-generation response data no longer includes the requester’s IP address.
